sentences: We play yes in the park.
I write yes in my book.

starters-young.definition: Not old; still a child or teenager.
starters-young.hint: A puppy is a young dog.
sentences: The young door is over there.
Can you see the young box?

starters-zebra.definition: An African horse with black stripes.
starters-zebra.hint: No two zebras have the same stripes.
starters-zebra.fact: Zebras live in groups called herds.
sentences: I can see a zebra at the zoo.
The zebra is in the garden.
Can you draw a zebra, please?
Mia has a book about a zebra.
We learn about a zebra at school.
Zoe points to a zebra in the picture.
My favourite animal is a zebra.

starters-zoo.definition: A place where wild animals are kept.
starters-zoo.definitionVi: Sở thú — xem động vật hoang dã.
starters-zoo.hint: You see lions and monkeys at the zoo.
sentences: We go to the zoo on Saturday.
There is a big zoo near my house.
Can we go to the zoo, please?
I can see the zoo in the picture.
We learn about the zoo at school.
